build_TransformerLanguageModel: build a transformer language model using TransformerLanguageModel.build_model with a fairseq task and config args
configure_TransformerLanguageModelConfig: configure a TransformerLanguageModelConfig dataclass to set decoder layers, embed dim, dropout, and attention heads
register_transformer_lm_architecture: register a new transformer_lm model architecture using register_model_architecture with custom hyperparameters
build_embedding: build a token embedding layer using TransformerLanguageModel.build_embedding with a dictionary and embed dimension
use_base_gpt3_architecture: use base_gpt3_architecture to configure GPT-3 style settings like learned positional embeddings and shared input output embeddings
